checked_points: The top layer is a genuine normal elementary-abelian subgroup of order8, including e=4.
Order-four marked actions are excluded by the unique fixed line of a regular unipotent.
The dihedral Frattini coset argument uses all three marked actions; right-conjugation order causes no ambiguity modulo Phi(R).
The image is C2^2 and its kernel is exactly Phi(P) by equal index.
The marked action is unique with common fixed line generated by u+v+w.
scope: Necessary top-layer action in a minimum unrestricted cyclic-TPP counterexample only. No nonexistence, catalogue, extension-existence, or priority claim.
